- File: scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh
  Line or code reference: 2064 (`printf '\n{{MODEL_FAMILY_OVERLAY}}\n' >> "${model_prompt_file}"`)
  Problem: The overlay-placeholder append to the per-reviewer prompt copy is not error-checked. Every other failure path in `prepare_reviewer_prompt_for_model` (overlay file read, prompt file copy, subshell render) wraps its operation in `if ! ...; then rm cleanup; log; return original` — but this `printf >>` is naked. Under `set -euo pipefail`, a disk-full or unwritable-temp condition here would abort the entire reviewer run instead of falling back to the original prompt.
  Why it fails at runtime: If `${prompt_work_dir}` becomes unwritable between the `cp` and the `printf`, the append exits non-zero and bash kills the reviewer process before Codex launches, wasting the review budget with no fallback.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
